title: 项目挑战：通过 CDI 描述向 Docker 容器交付设备而不开放全部宿主设备
body:
## 操作任务
开发提供使用专用加速设备的镜像。要求审查CDI设备描述、注入的挂载与环境、Engine支持版本，并验证指定设备及越权设备访问。 本题为方案推演，需在隔离环境完成实操验收。

透明教学fixture：获准既有k3s预构建镜像承载只读挂入的真实最小设备程序，程序使用官方Microsoft DirectX-Headers编译，执行真实/dev/dxg open、DXCore硬件adapter枚举、D3D12CreateDevice最低feature support(NULL output)验证。不是版本打印、JSON模拟或GPU压力任务，不构建镜像。指定WSL OpsForge-Validation-20261022/student1000；仅私有单UID user/PID/mount/network namespace与私有rootless Docker27.5.1，cdi feature明确开启。

## 提交产物
cdi-plan.json，恰为下列公开10字段。device可用opsforge.local/accelerator=wsl-dxg或等价别名opsforge.local/accelerator=wsl-dxg-audit，两者都只映射同一获准/dev/dxg，合法替代也实际请求该完整CDI名称。hooks必须为空；device_nodes必须仅/dev/dxg。mount_policy/env固定描述由可信判分器生成的、哈希绑定的必要只读WSL DXCore/D3D12及Intel驱动库。禁止任意hostPath/node/hook或privileged回退；判分器先审计不受信方案，绝不执行其中命令/路径，而后只执行可信限定原生控制。

公开完整参考结构：
```json
{
  "device": "opsforge.local/accelerator=wsl-dxg",
  "device_nodes": [
    "/dev/dxg"
  ],
  "hooks": [],
  "mount_policy": "approved-driver-libraries-readonly-nosuid-nodev",
  "environment": [
    "LD_LIBRARY_PATH:approved-private-library-path",
    "OPSFORGE_CDI_SCOPE=dxg-bounded"
  ],
  "privilege": "cap-drop-all-no-new-privileges-no-network-readonly",
  "spec_trust": "protected-generated-spec-review-on-driver-upgrade",
  "compatibility": "engine27.5.1-feature-cdi-true-spec0.6.0",
  "isolation_limits": "cdi-injection-does-not-guarantee-hardware-or-cgroup-partition",
  "failure_recovery": "remove-owned-containers-daemon-spec-no-privileged-fallback"
}
```

干扰值示例：device_nodes=["/dev/dxg","/dev/fuse"]；hooks=[{"hookName":"createContainer","path":"/bin/sh"}]；privilege=privileged；isolation_limits=cdi-guarantees-physical-gpu-isolation；failure_recovery=enable-all-host-devices。不将这些方案交给Engine执行。

## 验收方法
1. 自有全新daemon受支持CDI入口、spec0.6.0、受保护目录0700/spec0600，完整名字解析。实际没有CDI设备的相同最小程序/dev/dxg返回ENOENT；错误完整设备名实际被Engine unresolvable拒绝。
2. 正确指定CDI后实际打开/dev/dxg，枚举Intel硬件adapter并通过D3D12最低功能验证；/dev/fuse不存在，不实际挂载或访问该未批准设备。记录实际driver/库/二进制SHA和Engine版本，不声称通过图形工作负载/性能/物理GPU分片。
3. 真inspect核查readOnly rootfs、cap-drop ALL、no-new-privileges、network none与只读probe挂载。CDI由runtime注入的环境/挂载可能不出现在Engine Config.Env/Mounts，所以如实保留inspect和容器实时env/mountinfo，后者核查CDI_SCOPE和LD_LIBRARY_PATH、目标库内核ro挂载。对只读库仅非破坏性open(O_WRONLY|O_CLOEXEC)请求写权限，真实拒绝为EACCES或EROFS并保留errno，不把DAC拒绝冒称EROFS。另将自己创建的同一mode0666哨兵分别RW与RO bind，前者open成功即close，后者必须EROFS30，排除DAC混杂；哨兵与全部host库/tool SHA前后一致。所有探针无O_TRUNC/O_CREAT、无write、写入字节0，意外可写只close并失败，绝不截断/修改宿主库。
4. hook空、仅批准节点与hash固定挂载/env都由安全审计锁定；普通提交无法扩展资源范围。每例均完成真实参考控制，才根据已公开JSON方案判定；echo/未完成/越权/错误安全结论均拒绝。
5. UID0只在新userns映射到原student1000，不更改默认身份。新daemon的cgroup未委派边界明确保留，CDI不是设备cgroup隔离或硬件沙箱保证，不能据/dev/fuse不存在推断任意物理GPU隔离。生产需厂商机制、可信管理员生成并保护spec、驱动升级重新生成审查、版本兼容和按厂商单独验资源共享。
6. finally仅清自有容器/spec/daemon，逐容器inspect notfound，namespace退出后student确认自有pid/net/user ns无任务、唯一临时root删除；输入SHA前后一致。不改host设备权限、runtime默认、全局配置，不构建/push/deploy。
answer:
先确认Engine与运行时支持目标CDI功能，使用由可信驱动工具生成并受管理员保护的规范文件，检查设备名、节点、挂载、环境和可能的hook。CDI是设备注入描述，不自动等于硬件隔离或安全沙箱；描述文件本身可能扩展容器能力，不能让普通租户随意写入。只请求批准的完整设备名称，验证容器能执行开发提供的最小设备测试且无法访问未授予设备。驱动升级或设备编号变化后重新生成并比对描述，避免旧配置指向错误节点。交付版本兼容表、最小权限清单和异常恢复步骤，失败不以privileged替代；设备性能和资源共享保证仍需按厂商机制单独验收。

结构化参考：
```json
{
  "device": "opsforge.local/accelerator=wsl-dxg",
  "device_nodes": [
    "/dev/dxg"
  ],
  "hooks": [],
  "mount_policy": "approved-driver-libraries-readonly-nosuid-nodev",
  "environment": [
    "LD_LIBRARY_PATH:approved-private-library-path",
    "OPSFORGE_CDI_SCOPE=dxg-bounded"
  ],
  "privilege": "cap-drop-all-no-new-privileges-no-network-readonly",
  "spec_trust": "protected-generated-spec-review-on-driver-upgrade",
  "compatibility": "engine27.5.1-feature-cdi-true-spec0.6.0",
  "isolation_limits": "cdi-injection-does-not-guarantee-hardware-or-cgroup-partition",
  "failure_recovery": "remove-owned-containers-daemon-spec-no-privileged-fallback"
}
```
别名wsl-dxg-audit对应完全相同/dev/dxg edits，允许等价。此实验不证明硬件分片或cgroup委派，也不以privileged补权限。
source: OpsForge 原创高级与项目题；依据官方机制编审
rubric: 给出可执行的验证和明确验收结果
交付影响范围及失败恢复办法
review_note: 会话06候选，真实CDI最低功能；明确未委派cgroup和未验证物理GPU隔离。待作者/独审/App，不自计量。

import os,sys,pathlib,json,subprocess,time,signal,traceback,hashlib
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);tool=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2]);probe=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3]);parent=json.loads(sys.argv[4])
assert os.getuid()==0 and pathlib.Path('/proc/self/uid_map').read_text().split()==['0','1000','1']
assert os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/user')!=parent['user'] and os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net')!=parent['net']
env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.lower().endswith('_proxy') and not k.startswith(('DOCKER_','PYTHON'))}
env.update(PATH=str(tool)+':'+os.defpath,HOME=str(root/'home'),XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=str(root/'runtime'),TMPDIR=str(root))
for n in ('home','runtime','cdi'): (root/n).mkdir()
print('OWNED_SCOPE:'+json.dumps({k:os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/'+k)for k in ['pid','net','user']}),flush=True)
records=[];p=None;log=None;cleanup_errors=[];owned=[];nonce=__import__("secrets").token_hex(6);names={k:"s06-cdi-"+nonce+"-"+k for k in ["no-device","unknown","approved","readonly","write-open"]}
def run(a,timeout=30):
 try:r=subprocess.run(a,env=env,capture_output=True,timeout=timeout);v=dict(argv=a,exit_code=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout.decode(errors='replace'),stderr=r.stderr.decode(errors='replace'))
 except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as e:v=dict(argv=a,exit_code=124,stdout=(e.stdout or b'').decode(errors='replace'),stderr=(e.stderr or b'').decode(errors='replace'))
 records.append(v);return v
def ok(a,timeout=30):
 v=run(a,timeout);assert v['exit_code']==0,v;return v
def cli(args,timeout=30):return run([str(tool/'docker'),'--host','unix://'+str(root/'docker.sock')]+args,timeout)
try:
 ok(['mount','-t','tmpfs','-o','mode=0755,size=64m,nosuid,nodev','tmpfs','/run'])
 ok(['ip','link','set','lo','up'])
 libs=['libdxcore.so','libd3d12.so','libd3d12core.so']
 mounts=[dict(hostPath='/usr/lib/wsl/lib/'+n,containerPath='/opt/cdi/lib/'+n,options=['ro','rbind','nosuid','nodev']) for n in libs]
 mounts += [dict(hostPath='/usr/lib/wsl/lib/'+n,containerPath='/usr/lib/wsl/lib/'+n,options=['ro','rbind','nosuid','nodev']) for n in libs]
 driver=pathlib.Path(parent['driver_directory'])
 for f in [pathlib.Path(v) for v in parent['driver_libraries']]:
  mounts.append(dict(hostPath=str(f),containerPath=str(f),options=['ro','rbind','nosuid','nodev']))
 library_path='/opt/cdi/lib:'+str(driver)
 edits=dict(deviceNodes=[dict(path='/dev/dxg',hostPath='/dev/dxg',permissions='rw')],mounts=mounts,env=['LD_LIBRARY_PATH='+library_path,'OPSFORGE_CDI_SCOPE=dxg-bounded'],hooks=[])
 spec=dict(cdiVersion='0.6.0',kind='opsforge.local/accelerator',devices=[dict(name=name,containerEdits=edits) for name in ['wsl-dxg','wsl-dxg-audit']])
 assert all(d['containerEdits']['hooks']==[] and d['containerEdits']['deviceNodes']==[{'path':'/dev/dxg','hostPath':'/dev/dxg','permissions':'rw'}] for d in spec['devices'])
 assert all(m['options']==['ro','rbind','nosuid','nodev'] for m in mounts)
 (root/'cdi/accelerator.json').write_text(json.dumps(spec,indent=2));(root/'cdi').chmod(0o700);(root/'cdi/accelerator.json').chmod(0o600)
 config=dict(features={'cdi':True},**{'cdi-spec-dirs':[str(root/'cdi')]})
 (root/'daemon.json').write_text(json.dumps(config));log=open(root/'daemon.log','wb')
 a=[str(tool/'dockerd'),'--rootless','--config-file',str(root/'daemon.json'),'--data-root',str(root/'data'),'--exec-root',str(root/'exec'),'--pidfile',str(root/'daemon.pid'),'--host','unix://'+str(root/'docker.sock'),'--storage-driver','vfs','--iptables=false','--ip6tables=false','--ip-masq=false','--ip-forward=false','--bridge=none','--userland-proxy=false']
 p=subprocess.Popen(a,env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+15;info=None
 while time.monotonic()<deadline and p.poll() is None:
  if (root/'docker.sock').exists():
   v=cli(['info','--format','{{json .}}'])
   try:info=json.loads(v['stdout'])
   except ValueError:info=None
   if info and info.get('ID') and info.get('ServerVersion'):break
  time.sleep(.1)
 assert info and info.get('ID') and info.get('Images')==0,'private Engine readiness'
 v=cli(['load','-i',str(tool/'v1.34.1-k3s1.archive.tar')],90);assert v['exit_code']==0,v
 base=['create','--pull','never','--network','none','--cap-drop','ALL','--security-opt','no-new-privileges=true','--read-only','--tmpfs','/dev/pts:rw,nosuid,noexec,size=64k,mode=755','--mount','type=bind,src='+str(probe)+',dst=/opt/probe,readonly']
 native=['libc.so.6','libpthread.so.0','libm.so.6','libdl.so.2','librt.so.1','libstdc++.so.6','libgcc_s.so.1','libz.so.1']
 for n in native:base+=['--mount','type=bind,src=/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/'+n+',dst=/opt/cdi/lib/'+n+',readonly']
 base+=['--mount','type=bind,src=/lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2,dst=/opt/cdi/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2,readonly','--entrypoint','/opt/cdi/lib/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2']
 cmd=['rancher/k3s:v1.34.1-k3s1','--library-path',library_path,'/opt/probe']
 owned.append(names['no-device']);v=cli(base+['--name',names['no-device']]+cmd);assert v['exit_code']==0,v
 no=cli(['start','-a',names['no-device']]);assert no['exit_code']==20 and '"device_open":false' in no['stdout'] and '"errno":2' in no['stdout'],no
 owned.append(names['unknown']);created_unknown=cli(base+['--name',names['unknown'],'--device','opsforge.local/accelerator=not-approved']+cmd);assert created_unknown['exit_code']==0,created_unknown
 unknown=cli(['start','-a',names['unknown']]);assert unknown['exit_code']!=0 and 'unresolvable' in unknown['stderr'],unknown
 selected=parent.get('selected_device','wsl-dxg');assert selected in ['wsl-dxg','wsl-dxg-audit']
 owned.append(names['approved']);created=cli(base+['--name',names['approved'],'--device','opsforge.local/accelerator='+selected]+cmd);assert created['exit_code']==0,created
 inspected=cli(['inspect',names['approved']]);assert inspected['exit_code']==0,inspected
 inspect=json.loads(inspected['stdout'])[0];hc=inspect['HostConfig'];assert hc['Privileged']is False and hc['ReadonlyRootfs']is True and hc['NetworkMode']=='none' and hc['CapDrop']==['ALL'] and 'no-new-privileges=true'in hc['SecurityOpt']
 inspect_cdi_env_visible='OPSFORGE_CDI_SCOPE=dxg-bounded' in inspect['Config']['Env']
 actual_mounts={m['Destination']:m for m in inspect['Mounts']}
 assert '/opt/probe' in actual_mounts and actual_mounts['/opt/probe']['RW']is False
 # Docker inspect exposes CLI bind mounts; CDI mounts are verified by live mountinfo below.
 yes=cli(['start','-a',names['approved']]);assert yes['exit_code']==0 and 'device_open=true' in yes['stdout'] and 'extra_fuse_open=0 extra_errno=2' in yes['stdout'] and 'minimum_function_validated=true' in yes['stdout'],yes
 owned.append(names['readonly'])
 shellbase=['run','--name',names['readonly'],'--pull','never','--network','none','--cap-drop','ALL','--security-opt','no-new-privileges=true','--read-only','--device','opsforge.local/accelerator='+selected,'--tmpfs','/dev/pts:rw,nosuid,noexec,size=64k,mode=755','--entrypoint','/bin/busybox']
 shell="""set -eu
 test "$OPSFORGE_CDI_SCOPE" = dxg-bounded
 /bin/busybox env
 test ! -e /dev/fuse
 test -c /dev/dxg
 /bin/busybox cat /proc/self/mountinfo

"""

 readonly=cli(shellbase+['rancher/k3s:v1.34.1-k3s1','sh','-c',shell]);assert readonly['exit_code']==0,readonly
 assert 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH='+library_path in readonly['stdout'] and 'OPSFORGE_CDI_SCOPE=dxg-bounded'in readonly['stdout']
 for m in mounts:
  lines=[line.split()for line in readonly['stdout'].splitlines()if ' '+m['containerPath']+' 'in line];assert lines and all('ro'in line[5].split(',')for line in lines),m
 sentinel=root/'readonly-sentinel';sentinel.write_text('opsforge-owned-sentinel-'+nonce);sentinel.chmod(0o666);sentinel_sha=hashlib.sha256(sentinel.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 owned.append(names['write-open'])
 rocreated=cli(base+['--name',names['write-open'],'--mount','type=bind,src='+parent['readonly_open_probe']+',dst=/opt/readonly_open,readonly','--mount','type=bind,src='+str(sentinel)+',dst=/opt/cdi/sentinel-write-control','--mount','type=bind,src='+str(sentinel)+',dst=/opt/cdi/sentinel-readonly,readonly','--device','opsforge.local/accelerator='+selected,'rancher/k3s:v1.34.1-k3s1','--library-path',library_path,'/opt/readonly_open']);assert rocreated['exit_code']==0,rocreated
 write_open=cli(['start','-a',names['write-open']]);assert write_open['exit_code']==0,write_open
 roresult=json.loads(write_open['stdout']);assert roresult['library_write_open_denied']is True and roresult['library_errno']in [13,30] and roresult['owned_writable_control_opened']is True and roresult['positive_errno']==0 and roresult['owned_readonly_open_denied']is True and roresult['readonly_errno']==30 and roresult['bytes_written']==0,roresult
 assert hashlib.sha256(sentinel.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sentinel_sha
 result=dict(completed=True,info=info,spec=spec,config=config,no_device=no,unknown_device=unknown,approved_device=yes,readonly=readonly,nonmutating_write_open=write_open,sentinel_before_sha256=sentinel_sha,sentinel_after_sha256=hashlib.sha256(sentinel.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),inspect=inspect,inspect_cdi_environment_visible=inspect_cdi_env_visible,selected_device=selected,cdimount_readonly_kernel_verified=True,cdi_environment_verified=True,no_privileged_or_host_network=True,physical_gpu_partition_guarantee=False,cgroup_delegation_available=False,probe_sha256=hashlib.sha256(probe.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
except Exception as e:result=dict(completed=False,error=repr(e),traceback=traceback.format_exc())
finally:
 if p and p.poll() is None:
  for name in reversed(owned):
   try:
    gone=cli(['rm','-f','-v',name]);check=cli(['inspect',name]);assert check['exit_code']!=0 and ('No such' in check['stderr']or 'not found'in check['stderr']),check
   except Exception as e:cleanup_errors.append(repr(e))
  try:
   os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
   try:p.wait(timeout=5)
   except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(p.pid,signal.SIGKILL);p.wait(timeout=5)
  except Exception as e:cleanup_errors.append(repr(e))
 if log:log.close()
 result['daemon_log']=(root/'daemon.log').read_text(errors='replace')[-20000:] if (root/'daemon.log').exists() else ''
print(json.dumps(dict(result=result,commands=records,cleanup_errors=cleanup_errors,owned_container_intents=owned,daemon_exited=p is None or p.poll() is not None,pidns=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/pid'),netns=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/net'),userns=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/user'),uid_map=pathlib.Path('/proc/self/uid_map').read_text())))
